# Datawright web tools for Muse

Datawright web tools for Muse runs eleven read-only web-data tools by Datawright Labs on Apify and returns clean JSON: (1) dns — SPF, DMARC, DKIM, MX and MTA-STS checks; (2) ssl — SSL certificate expiry and domain expiry; (3) whois — WHOIS/RDAP lookups: registrar, domain age, expiry date, availability; (4) headers — HTTP security headers, HTTPS redirect, cookies, A-F grade; (5) links — broken-link and 404 crawls, grouped by page; (6) pagespeed — Lighthouse/PageSpeed scores and Core Web Vitals; (7) screenshot — full-page and mobile screenshots or URL to PDF; (8) sitemap — every URL in a site's sitemaps; (9) autocomplete — Google, YouTube and Bing autocomplete keyword ideas; (10) appcharts — Apple App Store top charts; (11) jobs — open jobs from Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable and SmartRecruiters boards. The tools only read public websites, DNS, TLS and registry data and never post or change anything. Runs are billed per result to your own Apify account (Apify's free plan includes monthly credit; most checks are about $0.001 per domain).
